items.titel: Three Ways Camunda Speaks MCP (And Why the Direction Matters)
items.samenvatting: Most MCP integrations go one direction. Camunda ships all three. As a client calling tools, as a server for queries, and as a callable process capability. Here's how, with one flight disruption scenario as the thread.
